provenance: v3 was frozen before v1.5, then its 39 errors were opened and explicitly used to develop v1.6. All v1/v2/v3 scores here are development or regression. No hidden v4 or later corpus is read.
architecture: clause-v1: mapped normalization → source/quote attribution → clauses → role/polarity/stage atoms → linked campaign evidence → unresolved-contradiction checks → priority
changes: Payment conditions are scoped to clauses and assigned entry, delivery, prize-price or unknown roles.
Negation and optionality apply to a particular condition; the same donation can conflict, an optional extra donation cannot cancel a required ticket.
Random/skill selection distinguish positive, denied, unknown and preliminary stages.
NFKC, mixed glyph and OCR normalization maps every quote to original UTF-16 offsets.
RU, KK and transliteration families expanded without case IDs, complete scenario text or prize/amount-specific labels.

limitations: Development results are not an independent accuracy estimate.
Clause boundaries, attribution, stages and semantic roles are heuristic and dictionary-based.
Synthetic agent-authored corpora do not establish real-world precision or time savings.
The classifier does not decide fraud, illegality, ownership or actual organizer revenue.
